scope: Node DATA arithmetic adapter for an A2 update that already includes source due, plus explicit logical NoOp owner boundary.
reviewed_invariants: SourceDueUpdate is public constructible DATA with no new authorization, serialization, key, domain or native capability.

The adapter projects only the proposed fee back to the old case fee, then independently invokes prepare_source_due; it compares the complete resulting AggregateUsage and optional shared SourceFeeDeltaIntent with the claimed update.
Already-accounted due 12 remains 12; proposed fee 24, altered provider/scope/amount or missing claimed delta is rejected. Some zero-fee delta remains distinct from None.

Existing first receipts remain immutable. The logical NoOp fixture retains every usage counter, first receipt and None fee delta; the generic increased-meter fixture is explicitly limited to DATA for a distinct newly authenticated one-shot opportunity.
limits: Root performed both recorded executions. The independent reviewer only read source and raw logs and verified their hashes; no additional build or test was run.

The fixtures do not execute actual A2/A4 authentication, literal validation, one-shot opportunity assignment, canonical history append rules or a logical copy transported across different native carriers.
Logical NoOp classification must occur only after authenticating and checking the same op3/op4 literals; this calculator cannot establish that classification or freshness from caller-supplied usage.
Actual first receipt, canonical provider/rate, accepted prefix, current root/import generation, funding/leases and atomic native writer remain A2/A4/native owner responsibilities.
No-default node tests and Clippy exclude default-feature TIR execution and do not demonstrate native restart/restore, UTXO locking or end-to-end payment.
